title: Status properties/IgnoreResting
html:
See also Status properties.

IgnoreResting is a status property. Conditions with this property are not removed after a long rest.

List of conditions with IgnoreResting

More...
Condition Effects
A Clown in Town
  • Rue the day you crossed a fey. You were cruel to Dolly Thrice; now you'll have to pay the price.
  • This condition can only be obtained by smashing the Moonlantern held by Kar'niss.
  • Applies clown makeup to the victim.
Anointed in Splendour
  • Has a +2 bonus to all  Saving Throws.
Arcane Hunger
  • Gale's spirit is being drained. He has  Disadvantage to Constitution  Saving Throws.
Arcanely Honed
  • Deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Aspect of the Elk Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +1.5 m (5 ft) bonus to Movement Speed.
Aspect of the Wolf Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks.
Astral Gravity
  • Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled.
  • Carrying capacity is tripled.
Astrally Projected
  • While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
At Death's Door
  • Advanced Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 6. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Moderate Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 4. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
At Death's Door
  • Emergent Toxic Infection. Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Wisdom are reduced by 2. The more the creature rests, the worse it feels.
Aura of Conquest
  •  Frightened enemies within 3 m (10 ft) take 5⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn.
Aura of Courage
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Frightened.
Aura of Devotion
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Charmed.
Aura of Hate
  • This creature and all fiends and undead within 3 m (10 ft) gain this creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their melee weapon damage.
Aura of Protection
  • The creature and its allies within 3 m (10 ft) gain the creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their saving throws.
Aura of Terror
  • Nearby enemies have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
  • Creatures that can't be  Frightened are immune to this aura.
Aura of Warding
  • The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.
Baleful Knowledge
  • Dark whispers pervade the creature's mind.  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Blade Ward
  • Has Resistance against ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
Blessing of Selûne
  • Selûne's radiance protects you against the lesser effects of the  Shadow Curse. But beware - even Her light cannot guard against the darkest shadows.
  • Permits safe passage through some of the Shadow-Cursed Lands without a light source.
  • Resistant to magical ⁠Necrotic damage.
BOOOAL's Benediction
  •  Advantage on  Attack Rolls against  Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL.
Bound
  • This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura.
  • Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.
Bull's Strength
  • Has  Advantage on Strength Checks.
  • Weight Limit doubled.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet.
  • Immune from if Wet.
  •  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
Burning Fiercely
  • Takes 1d10⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Castigated By Divinity
  • Affected entity is cursed by transgressed and irritable gods. When it falls unconscious, it immediately dies. Moreover, when it dies, a terrible envoy of the offended deity is conjured from the entity's corpse.
Cat's Grace
  • Has  Advantage on Dexterity Checks.
  • Only takes half damage from falling.
Curse of the Sired
  • Cursed by a victim he brought to Cazador many years ago, Astarion receives  Disadvantage on all  Saving Throws.
Cursed Vengeance
  • Any damage done against Oliver will be reflected twofold at the attacker.
Disintegrating Corpse

This corpse is not long for this world.

  • The affected entity's corpse disintegrates into a pile of ash upon death.
Duergar Poison
  • A rare poison has sickened the victim.
  • Cannot perform any Actions or Reactions.
  • Automatically fails any Saving Throws.
  • All attacks against the target have  Advantage and Critical Hit if within 3 m (10 ft).
  • Immune to  Prone
Encumbered
  • Carrying too much weight.
  •  Movement Speed is reduced, and  Jump distance is halved.
Enemy of Justice
  • Wanted for killing a guard. Allied guards will attack on sight.
Ever Radiant
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Radiant.
Explosive Hoard
  • This mound of coins is primed to explode.
Feverish
  • Increasingly feverish.  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Filth Fever.
Fiendish Resilience: Acid
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Cold
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Fire
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Force
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Force damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Piercing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Poison
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Radiant damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage.
Filth Fever
  • Crushed by fever.  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls, and  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will re-inflict the Filth Fever condition.
  • Duration: 25 turns
Flesh Rot
  • Flesh is decaying.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  • Vulnerable to all damage.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the duration ends, otherwise it is reapplied.
Galvanic Currents
  • Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning.
Githzerai Mind Barrier

Having assimilated a splinter of githzerai knowledge, mental barriers have been erected in the affected entity's mind. It has  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws.

God of Ambition
  • Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.
Greater Arcane Hunger
  • The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Saving Throws.
Greater Toughness
  • This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it.
Green Bed Regeneration
  • When starting your turn on  Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.
Heavily Encumbered
  • Carrying far too much weight.
  •  Movement Speed heavily reduced, and you can no longer climb or  Jump. You also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls, as well as Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws.
Hexed Weapon
  • The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it.
  • The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier.
  • When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that  Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.
High Spirits
  • The amulet's spirit lingers, making everything seem just a little more vibrant. Must succeed a Wisdom  Saving Throw when using the amulet's power, or become Hysterical.
Holy Fire
  • Takes 1~4⁠⁠Radiant damage per turn.
Idyllic Aura
  • Grants Silvanus' Blessing to creatures within range.
In Surgery
  • Unable to move while strapped onto the operating gurney.
Infernal Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
  • The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points
Infernal Legion
  • You are one, you are legion, without personality or individuality - born only to fight.
  • When within 20 m (67 ft) of another creature wearing a merregon's mask, Strength increases by 1 and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma decrease by 1 per nearby mask.
Ironwood Harmony
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning while imbued with the druidic magic of  Shillelagh.
Just Look At Those Cheekbones!
  • Gazing upon this depiction of themselves will bless the owner of this statue once per Long Rest.
Lathander's Light
  • Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded, unless they succeed a  Constitution Saving Throw.
Loviatar's Love
  • Pain is the path to clarity. When you have 30% Hit Points or less, you gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.
Marshal Undead
  • An undying magnitude grants the Death Knight and nearby undead  Advantage against being  Turned.
Medium Toughness
  • This material is unusually strong. Only a hit that deals at least 22 damage can damage it.
Morninglord's Bulwark
  • Lathander's warding light protects this door from any harm dealing less than 50 damage.
Myrkul's Gift
  • Gained  10 temporary hit points. Until it loses these temporary hit points, this creature deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic with weapon attacks and has Resistance to ⁠Cold and ⁠Necrotic damage.
Oath Broken
  • You have broken your sacred Oath and betrayed your beliefs. You can no longer use Channel Oath Charges.
  • You should go to camp and contemplate what happened and what comes next.
Open Wound
  • Creature has recently cut itself.
  • Will lead into the  Rotting condition if a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw fails.
  • Removed by healing.
Pact Weapon
  • The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical.
  • The weapon uses the caster's Charisma modifier for  Attack Rolls and damage rolls.
  • Prevents the weapon from being dropped or otherwise disarmed.
Paid the Price
  • You have a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but  Disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, you have  Disadvantage when attacking Hags.
Permanent Mind Sanctuary
  • While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
Petrified
  • Turned to stone. Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions.
Pixie Blessing
  • The Shadow Curse cannot affect this creature thanks to a pixie's protective magic.
Psionic Ward Aura
  • The gish and allies within 3 m (10 ft) have a +5 bonus to Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened.
Quickly Ticking Mine
  • This grenade will explode on the end of its turn!
Rage Impeded
  • Weighed down by Heavy Armour. Until the armour is removed, Raging won't grant extra damage, resistance to physical damage, or  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
Refreshed
  • Hit Point maximum increased by 10 until the next Long Rest.
  • Turns into  Nauseated after a Long Rest or after  Auntie Ethel turns hostile.
Ritual Component
  • Astarion is Incapacitated as part of a profane ritual until Helped.
Roiling Hellfire
  • Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Rotting
  • Open wound is starting to rot.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the condition expires from duration. Failure will lead to you gaining  Flesh Rot.
Sacrificial Lamb
  • Entity can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions while enveloped in vampiric magic.
  • If Cazador draws power from all the spawn bound this way three times, he will ascend.
Sapping Curse

This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer.

  • Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Target is cursed.
Severe Arcane Hunger
  • The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is severely weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Saving Throws. His movement speed is halved.
Shadow Curse
  • Without a light source, you will take 2d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage every turn. This damage doubles each turn the party members are affected by the Shadow Curse.
Shadow-Cursed Undead
  • Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever.
  • These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to ⁠Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.
Shar's Blessing: Barrier of Darkness
  • You have an  Advantage on  Saving Throws while in darkness or dim light.
Silvanus' Blessing
  • Has Proficiency in Nature and Animal Handling
Soul Oath
  • This creature has sworn a Soul Oath to protect its dark master. Should that master die, this creature will also succumb to death.
Sovereign's Protection
  • Protected from the myconids' mushroom traps by the Sovereign's spore sac.
  • Mushroom traps like Bibberbang are temporarily disabled for the affected creature, enabling safe passage.
Spectral Observer
  • Though you are too dangerous to mingle in person, Withers has allowed you to observe this gathering - but only observe.
Spore Servant
  • The animating spores of a myconid sovereign have taken over this dead creature's body, moving it according to the sovereign's will.
  • Resurrected creature is classified as a plant.
  • Immune to all  Frightened conditions,  Blinded conditions,  Befuddled,  Charmed,  Crown of Madness,  Friends,  Hideous Laughter,  Hold Person,  Mind Mastery, Noxious Fumes (Bibberbang), Paralysed, and  Sleeping.
  • Creature is resistant to ⁠Poison damage.
  • Creature is unable to cast spells or wild shape.
